push.title: W 4-3 vs Byron City | You: 9.6 (3rd best match performance of the season)
push.body:
Hot diggity, BellyTb1. A 9.6 against Byron City. I didn't know a forward could do some of that.

THE GOOD
+ 9 shots at Byron City's goal. Volume creates chances, and you created plenty.
+ Man of the Match, your 17th for us. You set the bar, now the rest of us get to chase it.
+ PhogsToffees scored and you were the reason. Take a bow.
+ Your 3rd best match performance of the season (9.6). Keep stacking those.
+ Missed tackles 0, down from your usual 2. Write that one down and stick it on the fridge.

THE BAD
- Tackles attempted 0, down from your usual 3. Fix it like this: Make yourself big in the box when they shoot. Blocks count, even if the stats don't.
- Lowest assists on the team: 0 (best was PhogsToffees's 2). We need more from you there, and I know you've got it.
- Lowest passes attempted on the team: 32 (best was PhogsToffees's 35). Mark my words: Show for it. Move into the passing lane and ask for the ball instead of hiding behind your marker.
- Shots on target: 78%. Halfway to the summit; the peak is 90%+.

Warm-up idea: Defend the space, not just the player. Stand in the lane they want to pass into.

BellyTb1, one more thing before you log off: You can't rush a good brisket or a good player.

That's the stuff. Same time next match? - Coach Lasso

push.title: W 4-3 vs Byron City | You: 9.3 (5th best match performance of the season)
push.body:
PhogsToffees, a 9.3. If confidence were contagious, you just gave the whole team a cold.

THE GOOD
+ 89% passing on 35 attempts, up from your usual 82%. You passed it like you meant every one.
+ 5 key passes (up from your usual 2). A good pass is a love note. You wrote a few.
+ A goal against Byron City. That's the stuff they write songs about. Bad songs, but songs.
+ BellyTb1 finished what you started. That's teamwork.
+ Your 5th best match performance of the season, at 9.3. Every season needs a few of these.

THE BAD
- Tackle success 0%, down from your usual 32%. Fundamentals: Every missed tackle leaves a runner free behind you. If you're not sure, contain and let cover arrive.
- Shots 1, down from your usual 4. Bread and butter: When you've got a clear look inside the box, pull the trigger. Hesitation lets defenders recover.

Drill of the day: Win it with your body before your foot: shoulder to shoulder, then poke it away.

Remember, PhogsToffees: A coach's whistle is just a fancy way of saying 'I care.'

That's a keeper of a performance. - Coach Lasso

push.body:
buddskees, an 8.2. Good enough to be proud of, close enough to great to be hungry.

THE GOOD
+ 1 assist. That's the kind of vision you can't teach. Well, I can try, but you already have it.
+ BellyTb1 scored, but that goal had your name in the credits.
+ Passes attempted 35, up from your usual 23. That's the stuff I want framed.
+ Tackles won 2, up from your usual 1. That's the bit I'll replay in my head on the drive home.
+ 3rd straight match at 7.5 match rating. I see you, and I like what I see.

THE BAD
- No shots. Real talk: Ask for it early in the half-space, where a first-time finish is on. Promise it's worth it.
- Misplaced passes 8, up from your usual 5. That needs to look different next time out.
- Lowest match rating on the team: 8.2 (best was BellyTb1's 9.6). Numbers don't lie, even when we wish they would.
- Lowest key passes on the team: 0 (best was PhogsToffees's 5). Try it this way: Carry it into space when nobody steps to you. Dribbling into a gap pulls defenders out of shape.
- 2 tackles won: -0.1. Room to grow.

Rep it: Live on the last defender's shoulder and time the run as the passer lifts their head.

Hey, buddskees. Believe it, then go do it.

Learn it, then leave it. - Coach Lasso
